search_log.scope: Ādiparvan 1.145–1.185; named roster and narrative connections checked in Sanskrit CE
search_log.method: Read verse text and speaker cues; extracted individually named persons only; excluded generic collectives and uncertain plurals.

notes: Sanskrit CE witness only; claims use status source_text_checked, not a translation review.
The svayaṃvara roster names many candidates; attendance is asserted only where Dhṛṣṭadyumna names the person in the assembled roster, not that every named attendee actually attempted the target.

Roster spelling duplicates/cognate forms are not merged unless identity is clear. Suvarcā (1.177.3 and 1.177.8) is one record because same named person likely; Suvarcas (1.177.9) remains separate. Bṛhadbala at 1.177.5 and Śibi-line Bṛhadbala at 1.177.15 remain separate records as possible homonym.
The request target of 120+ distinct individuals is not treated as a quota: names are included only when the CE supplies an individually distinguishable surface person.
